name: Clifftop Lookout
oracle_text:
Reach
When this creature enters, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card. Put that card onto the battlefield tapped and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card. Put that card onto the battlefield tapped and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

needs.what: a `tapped` option on the reveal_until op, so the card it stops at can be put onto the battlefield tapped (op_reveal_until calls _move_found with tapped=False hard-coded); alternatively an `as` binding on reveal_until naming the found card so a following `tap` op can tap exactly that card
needs.why_existing_wont_do: reveal_until does the scan, the destination 'battlefield' and the random bottoming exactly, but ignores `tapped`, and the loader refuses `destination_if` (whose branches can carry tapped: true) on anything but search_library/search_zones. reveal_until has no `as`, so a later `tap` cannot name the found land; tapping 'lands you control that entered this turn' would also tap a land played earlier in the turn. Without tapped the card would ramp an untapped land, a strictly better card.
